title: Ethambutol
overview: Ethambutol eliminates certain bacteria that cause tuberculosis (TB). It is used with other medicines to treat tuberculosis and to prevent you from giving the infection to others.

sections.Before taking ethambutol,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to ethambutol or any other drugs.Take ethambutol 1 hour before or 2 hours after antacids.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take while taking ethambutol. Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney disease, gout, or eye disorders such as cataracts.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while taking ethambutol, call your doctor.
sections.Ethambutol may cause side effects. Tell: loss of appetiteupset stomachvomitingnumbness and tingling in the hands or feet
sections.If you experience any of the following s: blurred visioninability to see the colors red and greensudden changes in visionskin rashitchingIf you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
